title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, information exposure, availability, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use in their network and update adoption probability via social contagion.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask policies; non-compliance may trigger denied entry or fines.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Media and peers broadcast messages that adjust risk perception, trust, and perceived efficacy.

interactions.name: mask_purchase_and_supply
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks subject to supplier inventory, price, and subsidies; access constraints affect adoption.

interactions.name: location_based_interaction
interactions.description: Contacts occur at locations with contact rates modified by mask usage and location characteristics.

interactions.name: policy_feedback
interactions.description: PolicyMaker monitors adoption (and optionally infection indicators) and adjusts mandates, enforcement, and campaigns.

interactions.name: household_influence
interactions.description: Household members influence each other’s adoption and share mask resources.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days elapsed to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration
metrics.description: Duration for which adoption remains above the threshold.

metrics.name: adoption_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption rates by age group, occupation, and socioeconomic status.

metrics.name: compliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Compliance rate in locations and periods where mandates apply.

metrics.name: mask_availability_rate
metrics.description: Share of individuals who report adequate access to masks.

metrics.name: purchase_rate
metrics.description: Number of mask purchases per day relative to population.

metrics.name: shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days where demand exceeds supply (inventory shortfalls).

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Inequality index (e.g., Gini) of adoption across socioeconomic groups.

metrics.name: policy_cost_proxy
metrics.description: Proxy for policy cost combining enforcement actions, fines, and subsidies.
